card.name: Partway through drug names and codes
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of a longer name or code, such as the 'l' in Norelgestromin, 'al' in lenalidomide, or the slash in dose combinations. Also joiners in file or setting names.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a long generic drug name, where the rest of the name is still to come.

modes.label: Separators in dose strings
modes.description: A slash or space between strength numbers in combination products.

modes.label: Code and path joins
modes.description: An underscore or punctuation piece inside a technical identifier or path.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it promotes words like handler and process, which are not related to the drug contexts.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of long drug names and in joins between dose numbers, before the name or value is complete.
